Question Choices: A researcher randomly assigns volunteers to receive either a new drug or a placebo. What type of study is this Choices: A) Experiment | B) Observational study | C) Survey | D) Census Answer with the letter only.

A survey asks every 10th person entering a mall about their shopping habits. Which population can the results be generalized to Choices: A) All people in the country | B) Shoppers at that mall on that day | C) All online shoppers | D) Everyone who owns a car Answer with the letter only.
Solution: Correct answer: B (Shoppers at that mall on that day).

Question Choices: Which sampling method gives every member of the population an equal chance of being chosen Choices: A) Convenience sample | B) Voluntary response sample | C) Simple random sample | D) Asking friends Answer with the letter only.

A study finds that people who drink more coffee have higher stress levels. Which conclusion is justified Choices: A) Coffee causes stress | B) Stress causes coffee drinking | C) There is an association between coffee and stress | D) Neither variable is related Answer with the letter only.
Solution: Correct answer: C (There is an association between coffee and stress).

Question Choices: Which is needed to establish a cause-and-effect relationship Choices: A) A large survey | B) A randomized controlled experiment | C) A strong correlation | D) A convenience sample Answer with the letter only.
Solution: Correct answer: B (A randomized controlled experiment).

Question Choices: What is the purpose of a control group Choices: A) To make the sample larger | B) To provide a comparison to the treatment group | C) To eliminate the need for random assignment | D) To guarantee the result Answer with the letter only.
Solution: Correct answer: B (To provide a comparison to the treatment group).

Bias occurs in a survey when Choices: A) The sample is very large | B) The sample systematically differs from the population | C) The questions are asked in person | D) The results are close to 50% Answer with the letter only.
